messages.content: I found out my friend has been talking behind my back to our mutual friends.
That stings in a specific way, finding out secondhand. Do you know what was actually said, or just that it happened?
I know the gist, apparently they called me dramatic to someone else.
Is there any truth in it that stings because it's partly accurate, or does it feel completely off-base to you?
Honestly maybe a little true, but still hurts they said it behind my back.

Both things can be true at once — the comment having a kernel of truth doesn't make saying it behind your back okay. Worth separating those two conversations: one about the trust breach, one about whether the feedback itself is worth reflecting on.
